title: get_history_messages params
description: Fetches one page of messages of a history session, oldest first. The session must have been loaded with load_history; otherwise the command fails with history_not_loaded. The response carries messages, total (all messages of the session), and the offset and limit that were used. Each message has text, data_base64, is_local, timestamp, when it was stored by the local clock, which orders the history, and sent_at, the time its sender put on it, which the sender can set to anything and which is left out for messages stored without one.

limit.description: Most messages to return. 0, a negative value or an absent limit means 500.

offset.description: Messages to skip from the oldest. A negative offset is read as 0, and one past the last message as the message count. Defaults to 0.
